assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm over an extended period, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated.
This service addresses diagnosis codes R55.
This service addresses diagnosis codes I47.1.
